business: Wag n' Wash Dog Groomers, Portishead, UK
colour: Light base + deep brand colour. White #FFFFFF base, soft mint tints #E7F4EF / #D5ECE4, deep teal #0E6B5C panels and headings, coral accent #E4574B (red-family, not orange) for CTAs and highlights. Ink text #17312B. Amber #E9A426 used only for star-rating glyphs. No orange UI accents anywhere. Restyled 10 Nov: square-cornered section labels (mint tile + coral left bar), rectangular 6px-radius buttons, 10px tile corners throughout.

design_log_check.differ_on_axes: archetype, hero, fonts, layout skeleton, signature — differs from every design-log entry on at least 4 of 6 axes
design_log_check.note: Bento grid was last used 2026-11-06, outside the last 10 archetypes in design-log.json (55 entries, last dated 2026-11-09).

fonts: Fredoka (display, 600/700) + Nunito (body) — self-hosted variable woff2 files (Google Fonts files downloaded locally; this VM's headless Chromium has no direct internet access, so CDN fonts render blank in local checks — same precedent as the 8–9 Nov builds). Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 likewise self-hosted (woff2 + local icon CSS).
hero: Bento-grid hero: a 4-column tile grid — the headline in its own mint tile (2x2, with coral 'Puppy's first groom?' tag, square-cornered kicker, CTAs and 5.0 rating), the Yorkie trim action shot as a large 2x2 photo tile, three smaller dog photo tiles, and a deep-teal 5.0-star stat tile. Sharp-ish 10px corners throughout. Hero shows the actual grooming service (scissors-and-comb trim).

honesty.notes: No invented reviews, ratings, prices, awards or staff. Testimonials are verbatim Google-review quotes (first name only) with a link to the Setmore page. Prices are not published anywhere found, so services carry 'Prices on request' exactly once. Staff named in reviews (Ella, Erin) are mentioned only as the groomers named in those reviews. Footer carries the CodeCrafters Hub design-concept disclaimer only; meta robots noindex set; no concept badges in hero/header.

image_format: WebP, 1600px + 800px srcset, every file under 250 KB
image_reuse_check: All 16 IDs checked against the 676 IDs in design-log.json — none reused. Every photo was viewed on a contact sheet before use; rejects included a Chewy-branded toy photo, guinea pigs, a cat, a gaming PC, headphones, a snail, a betta fish, an elephant, a speedboat, a vet-injection series and a stuffed-mushroom food shot.
image_viewing: All 16 used photos viewed at full tile size on contact sheets; hero tile (6816860, Yorkie trim) viewed at full size and confirmed: a real grooming trim in progress, dog calm, in focus.
mobile_menu: data-menu-toggle on the toggle button, data-mobile-menu on the dropdown nav; menu opens instantly (display toggle, no transition on the open/close transform); z-index above content; closes on link tap and Escape.
redesign_note: REDESIGN 10 Nov 2026 — fixes a uniqueness clash with Bohoo, Taif (built the same day): both sites used archetype 'Playful rounded' AND display font Baloo 2. This site was reworked to archetype 'Bento grid', display font Fredoka, bento-grid hero with headline tile + large trim tile + stat tile, bento-style service tiles (wide full-groom tile, full-width puppy tile), rectangular 6px buttons, square-cornered section labels, and a new section order (gallery directly after services; reviews after how-it-works). Same business facts, same 16 viewed images, same copy and honesty rules; research.json untouched.
section_order: 01 Hero — bento grid: headline tile + large trim tile + 3 dog tiles + 5.0 stat tile
02 Trust bar — 5.0 Google rating (106 reviews), fully insured & qualified, natural & vegan products, all breeds welcome
03 About — a calm little salon on Portishead High Street, with photo
04 Services — bento tiles: wide full groom, bath & wash, teeth cleaning, nail trims, skin treatments, full-width puppy first grooms (Prices on request, once)
06 First groom feature band — deep teal band, puppy photo, gentle first-visit steps
07 How a visit works — 4 steps with icons
08 Why locals choose — 4 verbatim Google-review quotes with source link
09 Visit — hours table + Google Maps embed + contact strip
10 FAQ — 5 questions answered from verified facts only
11 Book — booking form (mailto), call / email / Setmore buttons
signature: Bento-grid hero — headline in its own mint tile, large trim-action tile, three dog tiles and a deep-teal 5.0-star stat tile, all 10px corners
Bento services — wide full-groom tile and full-width puppy tile among standard tiles, square icon chips, no overlapping icons
Square-cornered section labels (mint tile + coral left bar) and rectangular 6px buttons throughout
Puppy's first groom feature band — deep teal, three-step gentle first visit, dachshund puppy photo
Lightbox gallery — 4-photo grid, keyboard-usable, with captions
tech: Static HTML + CSS + vanilla JS. Self-hosted fonts (Fredoka + Nunito variable woff2) and Bootstrap Icons woff2. No build step. No _headers file.
